text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Inari One takes first place! We have our
new dirt
champiooon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's victory today is a good sign
that she'll
be successful in the Tokyo
Daishoten. When I go
to check up on
her...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, yeaaah! Inari One is the
ONE!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm gonna keep this up
until—

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten, perhaps? Don't
go countin'
your chickens just yet.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
We'll be even stronger by the end of the
year. Ya
went 'n' lit a fire in us out there,
Inari.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how high those flames
climb, ya
have to show us ya can fly right
over 'em!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: That's what havin' true Oi spirit's about!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to that comin'
festival, where
you'll reach the top for
real.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll toughen up by the year's end. I've
got Oi spirit
in my heart...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next battle will be the Tokyo
Daishoten,
where the top of the
regionals is on the line!
